title: het-ai
description: A framework-agnostic MLOps training DSL for Python that provides a structured abstraction over the full machine learning training lifecycle (data loading, hyperparameter optimisation, model training, export, and experiment tracking) through a single, consistent interface, powered by Optuna and integrated with DVC data versioning and MLflow experiment tracking.
